description: Website change monitoring, step one: fetch a page and store it as the baseline to compare against later. Use it to watch pricing pages, terms, job boards or competitors. Input: url. Then call monitor.check to learn whether and how it changed. $0.50 per call. Returns: url, title, text_chars, content_hash, note.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

name: hubvibe_monitor_snapshot
title: Save a monitoring baseline
